an8.14:1.1: aṭṭha bhikkhave assakhaḷuṅge aṭṭha ca assadose desessāmi aṭṭha purisakhaḷuṅge aṭṭha ca purisadose
an8.14:2.1: katame ca bhikkhave aṭṭha assakhaḷuṅgā aṭṭha ca assadosā
an8.14:2.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco assakhaḷuṅgo pehīti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā pacchato paṭisakkati piṭṭhito rathaṃ pavatteti
an8.14:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave idhekacco assakhaḷuṅgo pehīti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā pacchā laṅghipati kubbaraṃ paharati tidaṇḍaṃ bhañjati
an8.14:4.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave idhekacco assakhaḷuṅgo pehīti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā rathīsāya satthiṃ ussajjitvā rathīsaṃ yeva ajjhomaddati
an8.14:5.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave idhekacco assakhaḷuṅko pehīti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā ummaggaṃ gaṇhāti ubbaṭumaṃ rathaṃ karoti
an8.14:6.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave idhekacco assakhaḷuṅgo pehīti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā laṅgheti purimaṃ kāyaṃ paggaṇhāti purime pāde
an8.14:7.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave idhekacco assakhaḷuṅgo pehīti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā anādayitvā paṭodayaṭṭhiṃ dantehi mukhādhānaṃ viddhaṃsitvā yenakāmaṃ pakkamati
an8.14:8.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave idhekacco assakhaḷuṅgo pehīti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā neva abhikkamati no paṭikkamati tattheva khīlaṭṭhāyiṭṭhito hoti
an8.14:9.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave idhekacco assakhaḷuṅgo pehīti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā purimeva pāde saṃharitvā pacchime pāde saṃharitvā tattheva cattāro pāde abhinisīdati
an8.14:9.4: ime kho bhikkhave aṭṭha assakhaḷuṅgā aṭṭha ca assadosā.
an8.14:10.1: katame ca bhikkhave aṭṭha purisakhaḷuṅgā aṭṭha ca purisadosā
an8.14:10.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuṃ bhikkhū āpattiyā codenti
an8.14:10.3: so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno na sarāmi na sarāmīti āpattiyāva nibbeṭheti
an8.14:10.4: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave assakhaḷuṅgo pehīti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā pacchato paṭisakkati piṭṭhito rathaṃ pavatteti
an8.14:11.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuṃ bhikkhū āpattiyā codenti
an8.14:11.2: so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno codanaṃ yeva paṭippharati
an8.14:11.3: kiṃ nu kho tuyhaṃ bālassa abyattassa bhaṇitena
an8.14:11.5: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave assakhaḷuṅgo pehīti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā pacchā laṅghipati kubbaraṃ paharati tiḍaṇḍaṃ bhañjati
an8.14:12.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuṃ bhikkhū āpattiyā codenti
an8.14:12.2: so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno codakasseva paccāropeti
an8.14:12.3: tvaṃpi khosi itthannāmaṃ āpattiṃ āpanno tvaṃ tāva paṭhamaṃ paṭikarohīti
an8.14:12.4: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave assakhaḷuṅgo pehīti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā rathīsāya satthiṃ ussajjitvā rathīsaṃ yeva ajjhomaddati
an8.14:13.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuṃ bhikkhū āpattiyā codenti
an8.14:13.2: so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno aññenāññaṃ paṭicarati bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmeti kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti
an8.14:13.3: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave assakhaḷuṅgo pehīti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā ummaggaṃ gaṇhāti ubbaṭumaṃ rathaṃ karoti
an8.14:14.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuṃ bhikkhū āpattiyā codenti
an8.14:14.2: so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno saṅghamajjhe bāhā vikkhepakaṃ bhaṇati
an8.14:14.3: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave assakhaḷuṅgo pehīti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā laṅgheti purimaṃ kāyaṃ paggaṇhāti purime pāde
an8.14:15.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuṃ bhikkhū āpattiyā codenti
an8.14:15.2: so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno anādayitvā saṅghaṃ anādayitvā codakaṃ sāpattikova yenakāmaṃ pakkamati
an8.14:15.3: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave assakhaḷuṅgo pehīti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā anādayitvā paṭodayaṭṭhiṃ dantehi mukhādhānaṃ viddhaṃsitvā yenakāmaṃ pakkamati
an8.14:16.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuṃ bhikkhū āpattiyā codenti
an8.14:16.2: so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno nevāhaṃ āpannomhi na panāhaṃ āpannomhīti so tuṇhībhāvena saṅghaṃ viheṭheti
an8.14:16.3: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave assakhaḷuṅgo pehīti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā neva abhikkamati no paṭikkamati tattheva khīlaṭṭhāyiṭṭhito hoti
an8.14:17.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuṃ bhikkhū āpattiyā codenti
an8.14:17.2: so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno evamāha
an8.14:17.3: kiṃ nu kho tumhe āyasmanto atibāḷhaṃ mayi byāvaṭā yāva idānāhaṃ sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattissāmīti
an8.14:17.5: idāni kho tumhe āyasmanto attamanā hothāti
an8.14:17.6: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave assakhaḷuṅgo pehīti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā purimeva pāde saṃharitvā pacchime pāde saṃharitvā tattheva cattāro pāde abhinisīdati
an8.14:17.10: ime kho bhikkhave aṭṭha purisakhaḷuṅgā aṭṭha ca purisadosāti. 15
